headline: Two recently opened wallets sent funds to the same new payee.

findings: A shared payee warrants comparison; it does not establish common control.

clause_quotes.quote: Two recently opened wallets sending to the same new payee within 24 hours may justify a linked-wallet investigation.

why_not_other_actions: Investigate both wallets; a shared payee alone does not establish coordination. [T03_shared_new_payee]
